title: David Freeman
summary: David joined Immuneering in 2026 as Senior Research Associate. Prior to joining Immuneering, David worked at Escient Pharmaceuticals, where he ran high-throughput screening and helped bring the company’s lead project to the clinic. David earned his B.S. in Biology from UCSD.
